profile.headline: Correct, Efficient, and Expressive Abstractions
profile.summary:
PL researcher turned software engineer, passionate about working on analyses and tools to help programmers construct correct, performant, and maintainable software.

Practical programming experience: meta-programming (Racket), dependently typed programming / theorem proving (Lean, Idris), functional programming (Haskell, OCaml), mainstream programming (Kotlin, Java, Python)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and improved Android Studio’s profilers and static analyzers

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Generalized symbolic execution for higher-order stateful programs, formalized in Lean
* Applied result to build higher-order contract verifier and higher-order counterexample generator for Racket

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented random valid program generator to automate bug-finding for the D8/R8 compiler/optimizer
* Applied research in relational programming and program synthesis

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Applied higher-order symbolic execution to statically verify dynamic contracts for Racket

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Researched Natural Language Processing algorithms and developed systems for real-time matching of conversations
* Developed Android social app in Scala and Java
